title: Phase 5.5 audit completed with CPU export and color controls
body: Audit report SHA256 1a30bb2f784a500a5f68ea4b655709609fb6640b04c71162a8eed537e67b5682. Sampled protected B2 master regions equal canonical source. Identity export controls reproduce delivery errors. Color roundtrip without lossy codec demonstrates a conversion contribution. Limited phase-3 temporal context does not establish a model or donor-information limit. Report separates measurements, hypotheses and recommendations. Recommendation: DO NOT START PHASE 6 YET; calibrated symmetric color/export experiment first, expanded temporal context next, conditional alternative inpainting last. No production/pipeline changes or paid cloud inference. CPU audit scripts and evidence retained.
